::: {#fig-linear-approximation-vector}

```{r}
#| label: linear-approximation-vector-r
#| echo: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
#| eval: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
#| fig-alt: >-
#|   Surface plot of f(beta) = 3 beta1 + 5 beta2^2 for beta1 from 0 to 2
#|   and beta2 from 1 to 3, a sheet that rises steeply in beta2 and gently
#|   in beta1. A flat vermilion plane, the linear approximation
#|   23 + 3 (beta1 - 1) + 20 (beta2 - 2), passes through the point
#|   (1, 2, 23), which is marked with a black point.
#|   The plane touches the sheet along the line beta2 = 2 and lies below it
#|   everywhere else.
la_c1_la <- seq(0, 2, length.out = 41)
la_c2_la <- seq(1, 3, length.out = 41)
la_lin1_la <- 3 * la_c1_la
la_quad2_la <- 5 * la_c2_la^2
la_step1_la <- 3 * (la_c1_la - 1)
la_step2_la <- 20 * (la_c2_la - 2)
la_surface_la <- outer(la_quad2_la, la_lin1_la, "+")
la_steps_la <- outer(la_step2_la, la_step1_la, "+")
la_plane_la <- la_steps_la + 23
la_point_la <- tibble::tibble(c1 = 1, c2 = 2, z = 23)
la_black_la <- list(color = "#000000", size = 5)
la_stops_la <- c(0, 1)
la_blue_cols_la <- c("#CCE0F0", "#0072B2")
la_red_cols_la <- c("#D55E00", "#D55E00")
la_blue_la <- list(la_stops_la, la_blue_cols_la)
la_red_la <- list(la_stops_la, la_red_cols_la)
la_eye_la <- list(x = 1.6, y = -1.6, z = 0.9)
la_camera_la <- list(eye = la_eye_la)
la_xaxis_la <- list(title = "beta1")
la_yaxis_la <- list(title = "beta2")
la_zaxis_la <- list(title = "f(beta)")
la_scene_la <- list(
  xaxis = la_xaxis_la,
  yaxis = la_yaxis_la,
  zaxis = la_zaxis_la,
  camera = la_camera_la
)
la_legend_la <- list(orientation = "h")
plotly::plot_ly() |>
  plotly::add_surface(
    x = la_c1_la,
    y = la_c2_la,
    z = la_surface_la,
    colorscale = la_blue_la,
    showscale = FALSE,
    opacity = 0.8
  ) |>
  plotly::add_surface(
    x = la_c1_la,
    y = la_c2_la,
    z = la_plane_la,
    colorscale = la_red_la,
    showscale = FALSE,
    opacity = 0.5
  ) |>
  plotly::add_trace(
    data = la_point_la,
    x = ~c1,
    y = ~c2,
    z = ~z,
    type = "scatter3d",
    mode = "markers",
    marker = la_black_la,
    name = "point of approximation"
  ) |>
  plotly::layout(scene = la_scene_la, legend = la_legend_la)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr isFALSE(knitr::is_html_output())
#| results: asis
cat(
  "*(This 3D surface is interactive; see the HTML or slide version",
  "of this page to view it.)*"
)
```

The [graph](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-graph) of $f(\vcoef) = 3 \coef{1} + 5 \coef{2}^2$ (blue)
and [its linear approximation](#def-linear-approximation-vector) at $\tp{(1, 2)}$ (vermilion),
drawn as a function of the point $\tp{(1, 2)} + \stepvec$.
The two surfaces touch along the line $\coef{2} = 2$.

:::
